criteria_template.min_pairs_rule: ceil(0.90 * planned_cases) independently per station and primary horizon

criterion_interpretation.coverage: Operational completeness choice, not a statistical sufficiency guarantee; do not drop missing days.
criterion_interpretation.observed_event_floor: One is only the computability floor; NOT adequate sample size or independent-event support.
criterion_interpretation.extremes: Require paired interval lower bound recall difference >= 0 and upper bound FAR difference <= 0.
criterion_interpretation.precision: Difference interval width <= 0.10 is a prospective precision requirement, not demonstrated accuracy.
criterion_interpretation.absolute_gain: Report mm/day; 0.5 mm/day remains sensitivity analysis only, not an invented validated physical threshold.
criterion_interpretation.aggregation: Primary pooled paired D1 cases with per-station coverage and extreme-protection checks; secondary strata exploratory.

uncertainty.method: paired temporal date blocks preserving stations and leads together

multiplicity.extreme_guards: all must hold for any promotion claim

basis.coverage_and_precision: Conservative prospective engineering/scientific design choices under user delegation, not external standards.
basis.uncertainty: NIST warns against normal approximations with sparse binomial outcomes; forecast verification research requires temporal dependence handling.
